name: Phase-Displaced
desc: $Market was dragged through p-space from the Outer Reaches. Its orbit is new and its rock is not, and the survey records still disagree on where it used to be.

name: Neutron-Forged Mantle
desc: Ages beside a neutron star crushed the mantle of $market into dense, metal-rich strata. Garrisons dig in easily. Mining crews file complaints about their drill heads.

name: Residual Wormhole Throat
desc: The phase pull left a stable fold in space above $market. Traffic control routes freighters through it and logs the missing hours as weather.

name: Hypershunt-Bathed
desc: $Market spent cycles in the beam of a coronal hypershunt. Its crust still holds charge like a capacitor, and the colonial grid draws on it without asking.

name: Remnant Nanoforge Seams
desc: Veins of dormant Remnant nanoforge run through the bedrock of $market. They wake for the shipyards and for nothing else, which suits the shipyards.

name: Cryo-Locked Aquifers
desc: Frozen reservoirs lie under the crust of $market, sealed in by the cold of the Outer Reaches. Thawing them is slow work and well rewarded.

name: Furnace Heart
desc: The core of $market never cooled after its time beside a furnace star. Smelters sit straight over the vents, and the hazard allowance is generous.

name: Abyssal Bloom
desc: Something from the Abyss took root on $market and spread. It is edible. The survey team recommends not asking further.
